title: Elodie and the Visitor
author: Ivo Eastwick
blurb: August Zhou, the new teacher at a school with a missing-class problem, has spent fifteen years telling themselves the noises have explanations. Then all the photographs from grandma's house now include an extra chair — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must get the family out ahead of the count, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
